component.name: ApiTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "makeRequest" end sub
sub makeRequest() request = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") request.SetUrl(m.top.url) request.AddHeader("Accept", "application/json") request.AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json") request.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") request.InitClientCertificates()
port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") request.SetPort(port)
if request.AsyncGetToString() then while true msg = wait(5000, port) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" then code = msg.GetResponseCode() m.top.responseCode = code
if code = 200 then m.top.response = msg.GetString() else dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") m.top.response = "ERROR:" + code.toStr() + ":" + dt.AsSeconds().toStr() end if exit while
else if msg = invalid then ' Timeout dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") m.top.responseCode = 0 m.top.response = "TIMEOUT:" + dt.AsSeconds().toStr() exit while end if end while else dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") m.top.responseCode = -1 m.top.response = "ERROR:-1:" + dt.AsSeconds().toStr() end if end sub
